productShortDescription: The Wi-Fi-enabled Garmin VIRB Elite action camera harnesses the power of GPS allowing video recordings that automatically start and stop with GPS-enabled triggers you set, such as speed or altitude.
productFullDescription:
The Wi-Fi-enabled Garmin VIRB Elite action camera harnesses the power of GPS allowing video recordings that automatically start and stop with GPS-enabled triggers you set, such as speed or altitude.  

  • High-sensitivity GPS, accelerometer and altimeter capture key data, including location, speed and altitude 
  • With the on-board GPS and use-specific profiles such as ski mode, you can automatically start and stop recording with triggers such as minimum/maximum speed or altitude 
  • Has Wi-Fi and ANT+ connectivity to use the Garmin VIRB Elite with your iPhone or Android via free mobile apps 
  • High-quality glass lens accommodates wide, medium and narrow shooting modes; high-resolution, color LCD display offers preview, playback and easy control of camera settings 
  • 16MP sensor processes four HD video modes (1080p at 30fps, 960p at 30/48fps, 720p at 30/60fps and 848x480 at 120fps) and still images (16MP at 4:3, 12MP at 16:9 and 8MP at 4:3 
  • Achieve clear, true-to-life imagery with HDR (High Dynamic Range), ANR (Advanced Noise Reduction) and LDC (Lens Distortion Correction) capabilities 
  • Easily record photo bursts (16 per second at 6fps, 12 per second at 10fps and 8 per second at 15fps) and time lapses (0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 30 and 60 seconds) 
  • ANT+ wireless enables remote control and data transfer with other compatible Garmin products; edit and share your footage with free Garmin BaseCamp software 
  • Enjoy an easy slider switch for instant recording and on/off power, an internal stereo mic, external USB jack, composite A/V adapter and microHDMI output for video playback 
  • Removable, rechargeable 2000mAh lithium‐ion battery offers up to 3.5 hrs. at 1080p; microSD card socket accepts cards up to 64GB for memory storage (cards sold separately) 
  • Compact, unobtrusive and rugged design stands up to the bumps and drops that come with outdoor fun; it's also waterproof down to 1m for up to 30 min. 
  • The Garmin VIRB Elite action camera comes with a cradle, short and right-angle attachment links, flat and curved-surface mounts, mount adapter and USB cable

productShortDescription: The JVC GC-XA2 ADIXXION Action Camera is a lightweight and rugged action camera that is compatible with a variety of optional mounts for use in a variety of conditions, environments, and activities.
productFullDescription:
The pocket-sized JVC ADIXXION Cam 2 action camera has built-in Wi-Fi, a 1.5-in. LCD monitor and a rugged design that shrugs water, dust and freezing temps without the need for a separate housing. 

 
  • The ADIXXION lets you record all the action in 1080/60p full HD; gyro-sensor image stabilizer reduces shake; and super-wide lens expands your viewing angle 
  • 8 mega-pixel back-illuminated CMOS captures a high resolution image and combined with the F2.4 lens, gives excellent low-light performance 
  • Dual standard tripod mounts allow use of a wide range of accessories
  • Built-in 1.5-in. LCD monitor features 112,000-pixel resolution, auto brightness and auto off 
  • Wi-Fi and Quad View create a fast wireless connection that syncs to iOS and Android smartphones for remote control and video monitoring of up to four ADIXXION cameras at once 
  • 5X digital zoom; 16-megapixel ultra-resolution stills; high-speed burst photos; simultaneous recording of video and stills; time-lapse stills; 720/120p high-speed recording 
  • Gyro Sensor digital image stabilizer helps take the shake out of your video; integrated mic with 128 kbps audio ensures clear, high-quality sound 
  • Connections include mini HDMI output, USB for computer connections and battery charging and SD/SDHC/SDXC card slot 
  • Enjoy easy operation with on-board video effects, on-screen menu system, auto and manual white balance and simple USB battery charging 
  • Works with iMovie and Final Cut Pro X for easy video editing, sharing and archiving; USTREAM video streaming allows you to easily upload video to Youtube and other video sites. 
  • The JVC ADIXXION Cam 2 action camera is waterproof to 5m, shockproof for drops from 2m, dustproof and freezeproof; battery provides up to 2 hrs. 5 min. record time

productName: Sony Action Cam Wearable Camcorder + GPS
productShortDescription: With Wi-Fi connectivity and GPS that tracks your location and speed, the optically-brilliant Sony Action Cam Wearable Camcorder + GPS lets you capture and share all your fast-action experiences.
productFullDescription:
With Wi-Fi connectivity and GPS that tracks your location and speed, the optically-brilliant Sony Action Cam Wearable Camcorder + GPS lets you capture and share all your fast-action experiences.  

  • Built-in GPS can be used in conjunction with the free PlayMemories™ Home software to track your speed and performance 
  • Location, trail and speed information add more layers to your ability to analyze your performance that can be captured and displayed on your video 
  • Weighs in at just 3.2 oz. with battery so you can capture your adventures on the mountain, in the water and anywhere else you go for your adrenaline fixes 
  • Action Cam includes a rugged, waterproof housing with tripod mount; camera is waterproof down to 60m (197 ft.), and is nearly impervious to mud, snow and grime 
  • Ultra-wide-angle Carl Zeiss® Tessar® F2.8 lens offers amazing optics; 170° viewing angle ensures it's not just you in the picture but everything around you 
  • Camera features built-in Wi-Fi, image stabilizer and high-definition recording with 1920 x 1080 at 30 fps and 1280 x 720 at 60 fps
  • HD Slow 2x and HD Slow 4x let you slow it all down; ideal for studying and refining form and technique 
  • Full high-definition resolution lets you capture every kicked-up rock and every drop of sweat; capable of 30p recording and playback via HDMI® and compatible HDTV 
  • Share your footage in a snap via Wi-Fi-enabled mobile phones and tablets running the free PlayMemories Mobile™ application 
  • Select the clips and the camera will transfer and compress web-optimized movies and photos without a single cable; then share your cuts on the web and social media apps 
  • Whether you're mountain biking, skiing, skateboarding or surfing, SteadyShot® image stabilization and Active Mode deliver stunningly smooth wide-angle to telephoto video
  • Turn on the shake canceling mode for added electronic stability and even smoother video capture
  • The Action Cam Wearable Camcorder + GPS ships with 2 adhesive, quick-connect mounts; optional accessories from Sony (not included) let you mount the cam just about anywhere

  • Lid is 50% stiffer than non-SkyBox-series lids, cutting down on vibrations and making it simple to open and close

  • Box fits round, square and most factory-rack crossbars (not included); crossbars are required for mounting
  • SKS lock cores included
  • Fits crossbar spreads as short as 24 in.

No step stool required! This Thule Transporter cargo box mounts to your hitch, not your rooftop, making it easy to access all your gear.

  • Tilt-down design offers quick and easy access to the rear of your vehicle
  • Comes complete with 1.25 and 2 in. receiver hitch adapters for added versatility
  • Includes Thule's One Key System® and 4-pin pre-wired taillights
  • Also includes LPA license plate adapter so you're still street legal
  • Carrying capacity is a hefty 165 lbs.
  • Requires 1.25 or 2 in. receiver hitch, Class II or higher

  • Easy-grip mounting assembles quickly and easily attaches to car rack
  • Thule Pulse roof box has a SecureLock feature that ensures cargo box is closed securely

productName: Yakima DoubleDown Ace Hitch Rack - 4 Bike
productShortDescription: The Yakima DoubleDown Ace 4 bike rack gives you the best of both worlds by safely transporting up to 4 bikes, and then providing easy access to your vehicle.
productFullDescription:
The Yakima DoubleDown Ace 4 bike rack gives you the best of both worlds by safely transporting up to 4 bikes, and then providing easy access to your vehicle.

  • Installation to vehicle is a breeze and requires no tools; rack locks to hitch for security
  • Once bikes are removed, tilt-down mast lowers rack out of the way to provide access to back of vehicle
  • Fits most bikes, but an adapter (sold separately) may be required for women’s or kids’ bikes; not designed for use with tandem or recumbent bikes
  • Anti-sway bike cradles eliminate bike-to-bike contact and bike-to-vehicle contact
  • Rubber straps on each cradle securely anchor bike into place
  • Cradle arms can be lowered when not in use
  • Intuitive levers with anti-pinch trigger covers make folding cradle arms and mast a simple endeavor
  • Fits 1.25 in. and 2 in. receiver hitches; designed for Class II hitches and higher
  • Includes a hitch lock to lock rack onto your hitch
  • DoubleDown Ace 4 bike rack has 2 integrated bottle openers—1 at the end of each arm
  • Not intended for tandem or recumbent bikes; carrying bikes with step-through frames requires the purchase of an adapter (sold separately)

productShortDescription: Thule introduces the Raceway 2-bike trunk rack aimed at easy installation and even easier loading for up to 2 bikes.
productFullDescription:
Thule introduces the Raceway 2-bike trunk rack aimed at easy installation and even easier loading for up to 2 bikes.

  • Rack comes preassembled with 4 attachment straps (with vinyl coated steel cables) to secure the rack to your vehicle
  • Injection-molded nylon and extruded aluminum frame construction is lightweight yet superstrong; molded rubber pads at contact points protect vehicle
  • No Sway Cage™ anti-sway device prevents bike-to-bike contact
  • Oversize, easy-to-grip ratcheting knobs make mounting and adjusting bike rack practically hassle free
  • Narrow cradle arm design will accommodate most bicycle frame designs including smaller child bike frames; bike arms fold down when not in use
  • Easily fits a wide range of vehicle styles: sedans, hatchbacks and minivans; compatible with most factory spoilers
  • Thule Raceway 2 bike trunk rack weighs 20 lbs.
  • Not intended for tandem or recumbent bikes; carrying bikes with step-through frames requires the purchase of an adapter (sold separately)

productFullDescription:
Use the Yakima HitchSki with your existing hitch bike rack to convert it into an efficient hauling machine for 6 pairs of skis or 4 snowboards.

  • Fits most 4- and 5-bike mast-style dual-arm hitch racks (sold separately)
  • Features 2-position upper arms and adjustable lower arm
  • Includes SKS lock cores to secure your gear

  • Fits Thule and Yakima load bars
  • Includes lift system, integrated padded support, mounting hardware and all straps necessary to transport one kayak
  • Locks to load bar, (locks sold separately)
